topic: selection versus within-lineage response change in IFNγ-primed IDO1 memory of human MSCs

claims.claim: Bedford et al. report an IDO1-positive fraction of 70.2±0.9% after a single 10 h first-time IFNγ stimulus and 98.5±0.1% after 10 h rechallenge following a distinct 24 h priming pulse and 10-day rest; the primed cultures undergo 2.3±0.1 cumulative population doublings over the rest.
assumptions: Values and schedule are transcribed from Bedford et al. bioRxiv v1 Results/Fig. 1 and Methods.
Population doublings are population-level net growth estimated by serial cell counts, not responder-class or clone-specific survival.
claims.novelty_boundary: Source-reported findings in a preprint explicitly not certified by peer review; no novelty judgment for the biological finding.
claims.costs: Source PDF and supplement inspected; no raw flow cytometry, time-lapse trajectories, or clone-resolved counts acquired.
claims.falsifier: An erratum or source-data correction changing the reported values or schedule.
claims.next_gate: Obtain the responder distribution and lineage-specific growth/death over the exact 24 h priming plus 10-day rest schedule.

claims.claim: In a two-immutable-class model with rest-start responder fraction p, endpoint responder fraction q, and total descendant yield G, class mean yields are g_R=qG/p and g_N=(1-q)G/(1-p); no sub-replacement yield of N is possible exactly when p≥1−G(1−q).
assumptions: Two exhaustive classes R and N exist at the start of rest.
Class membership is immutable through the rest and rechallenge.
The endpoint assay classifies R and N without error, and G is the total endpoint yield per rest-start cell.
Class yields may differ and are nonnegative.
claims.novelty_boundary: Direct count balance; a standard conditional calculation, not a novel theorem or biological result.
claims.costs: Requires p at the actual rest-start and G on the same cohort/denominator; both must include cell loss, sampling and passage history.
claims.falsifier: A data/model audit showing the class counts or endpoint yield do not satisfy the stated conservation equations under the assumptions.
claims.next_gate: Measure p and class-specific absolute lineage yield on the exact protocol, or reject the binary fixed-class model.

claims.claim: Using source-reported means q=0.985 and D=2.3 gives G=2^D≈4.9246 and a sharp p threshold of approximately 0.9261 for no sub-replacement net yield of fixed-class nonresponders; p is latent class membership, not observed IDO1 positivity at rest start, and the source-reported 70.2% fraction is not a valid p input because it uses a different pulse duration and arm.
assumptions: The two-class model in C7-2 applies.
Reported means are used as point inputs, not interpreted as a joint confidence interval.
p is the latent fixed-class responder fraction at the start of the trained arm's rest.
claims.novelty_boundary: A source-specific data gate from elementary algebra; it does not show whether selection occurred.
claims.costs: No rest-start latent-responder measurement or class-specific death/growth trajectory is public in the inspected source.
claims.falsifier: Direct measurement of p and absolute class yields inconsistent with the predicted threshold under the fixed-class model.
claims.next_gate: Measure reporter state during the actual 24 h priming, validate it as a predictor for latent post-rest response class, and track full cell pedigrees through rest and rechallenge.

claims.claim: Aggregate endpoint fraction and total yield cannot distinguish immutable-class selection from state switching; moreover, increased endpoint response fraction within a coarse barcode can still be explained by selection among hidden response-heterogeneous sublineages.
assumptions: The class yields or transition fractions are not independently constrained.
A barcode labels common ancestry but may contain more than one response state at the measured starting time.
claims.novelty_boundary: Exact counterexamples are model-identifiability results, not claims that hidden sublineages occurred in the Bedford experiment. Clonal multiomics and IFNγ single-cell memory are already primary-literature prior art.
claims.costs: Requires prospective same-cell state readout plus complete birth/death/lineage records; endpoint multiomics is destructive and cannot read the exact earlier mark in the same cell.
claims.falsifier: An independently validated measurement that makes within-barcode starting-state heterogeneity impossible and measures every relevant lineage transition and loss.
claims.next_gate: Use a validated live endogenous reporter and complete pedigrees; pair it with endpoint chromatin profiling only as an association layer.

claims.claim: The proposed generic advance of using single-cell response fractions or lineage-linked multiomics to establish epigenetic memory and separate selection from state change is preempted by prior primary IFNγ-memory and clonal multiomics studies; the Bedford MSC/IDO1-specific selection question remains unresolved, not novel as a general principle.
assumptions: The cited primary studies are accurately characterized in sources/NOTES.md.
A bounded search can establish close prior art but cannot establish exhaustive priority.
claims.novelty_boundary: Bounded primary-literature audit only; no exhaustive priority or expert novelty determination.
claims.costs: Primary articles inspected via publisher/PMC records; no attempt to enumerate all cell memory and live lineage-tracing literature.
claims.falsifier: A narrower, technically distinct capability with materially different prediction and decisive test that is not covered by the cited methods/results.
claims.next_gate: Do not promote the candidate absent such a distinction; retain the source-specific p/growth measurement gap as the actionable question.

scientific_status: No novel principle, theorem, or biological mechanism established. The defensible output is a conditional selection-feasibility gate, exact selection/switching aliases, source-premise correction, and discriminating same-lineage measurement design.
next_observation_that_could_change_statu: On the exact Bedford protocol, measure first-pulse IDO1 response distributions during the 24 h priming and validate whether these predict latent post-rest response class; time-lapse all founders and descendants through the ten-day rest and 10 h rechallenge with endogenous response reporting and complete birth/death/attrition capture; link endpoint chromatin state by lineage.
